title: FEATURED INVESTIGATION · Rendlesham Forest (1980)
source: UK National Archives / Ministry of Defence
description: USAF personnel reported unusual lights near RAF Woodbridge in Suffolk in December 1980. Contemporary official correspondence exists; the interpretations of the sightings remain disputed.

title: FEATURED INVESTIGATION · USS Nimitz / Tic Tac (2004)
description: Navy personnel described an unusual encounter during operations off Southern California in November 2004. The Department of Defense officially released the associated FLIR video in April 2020, while leaving the observed phenomena characterized as unidentified.

title: FEATURED INVESTIGATION · Roswell (1947)
source: US National Archives / US Air Force
description: Army Air Forces personnel recovered debris near Roswell in July 1947. Later accounts asserted an alien craft and occupants; the Air Force's subsequent investigations attributed recovered debris to Project MOGUL balloon research. These conclusions are disputed by some witnesses and researchers.

title: UK Ministry of Defence UFO records: research guide
description: How to locate UK Ministry of Defence sighting files, official correspondence and policy records. Many early files were destroyed under historic retention rules.

title: UK National Archives: UFO reports collection
description: UK government-held reports and correspondence, including eyewitness accounts and prosaic explanations. The existence of a file does not validate its claims.

title: UK UFO desk closure and final released files
description: National Archives account of the final MoD UFO files covering the 2007–2009 period and the UFO desk closure in 2009.

title: Project Blue Book: USAF investigation records
description: Official archived Air Force program documentation, case files and indexing information. Unidentified does not imply extraterrestrial.

title: Project Blue Book individual sighting case files
description: Catalogue overview of declassified USAF case-file series and related historical material held by NARA.

title: Japan Airlines Flight 1628: FAA 1986 information releases
description: NARA lists the FAA information-release series relating to Japan Airlines Flight 1628, a reported aerial encounter.

title: Roswell source files and official investigative records
description: NARA inventory identifies the Roswell Report source files and related historical records. The case remains controversial; this entry documents records, not alien recovery.

title: Project Blue Book: historical film and sound records
description: Find motion picture films and sound recordings connected with Project Blue Book investigations.

title: US National Archives UAP digitised records bulk catalogue
description: Catalogue and download options for extensive archival UFO/UAP record collections. Large datasets may require substantial storage.
